verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents allocating budgets to teams or projects, or card spending limits tied to such budgets. The closest items are adjacent controls: card configurations restrict time, day-of-week and merchant category rather than budget amounts. Labels attach cost centers or project IDs to transactions only after the fact, for reconciliation. 'Approvals' appear only in generic expense-reporting marketing, and the 'chasing budgets' line describes AI insights, not enforcement.
